question: How can I track my order?
variants: check delivery status of my order
answer: You can track your order under My Account > Orders, or just tell me your order number and I'll check it for you.

question: How do I cancel my order?
variants: i want to cancel a purchase
answer: You can cancel an order free of charge before it ships: go to My Account > Orders, select the order and tap Cancel. Once shipped, you'll need to return it instead.

question: Can I change or modify my order after placing it?
answer: Orders can be edited within 1 hour of placing them from My Account > Orders > Edit. After that the order is sent to the warehouse, so it's best to cancel and reorder if it hasn't shipped.

question: How do I change my delivery address?
answer: You can change the delivery address before the order ships from My Account > Orders > Change Address. If it has already shipped, contact the courier using the tracking link to reroute it.

question: How long does delivery take?
answer: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days, express delivery takes 1 to 2 business days, and same-day delivery is available in select metro cities for orders placed before 12 PM.

question: How much does shipping cost?
answer: Shipping is free on orders above Rs. 499. Below that, standard delivery costs Rs. 49 and express delivery costs Rs. 99.

question: Do you ship internationally?
answer: Yes, we ship to over 20 countries. International delivery takes 7 to 14 business days, and customs duties are paid by the customer on delivery.

question: My order is late, what should I do?
answer: Sorry about the delay! Delays usually clear within 48 hours. Share your order number and I'll check its status; if it's more than 3 days past the expected date, we'll escalate it with the courier.

question: I received a damaged or defective item
answer: I'm sorry about that. Please report it within 7 days from My Account > Orders > Report a Problem with a photo of the item. We'll send a free replacement or a full refund, and pick up the damaged item at no cost.

question: I received the wrong item
variants: this is not what i ordered
answer: Sorry for the mix-up! Go to My Account > Orders > Report a Problem and choose 'Wrong item received'. We'll arrange a free pickup and ship the correct item right away.

question: An item is missing from my package
variants: part of my order is missing
answer: Some orders ship in multiple packages, so please check your tracking page first. If an item is still missing, report it within 48 hours of delivery from My Account > Orders > Report a Problem.

question: What is your return policy?
answer: Most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery if unused and in original packaging. Innerwear, personal care items and gift cards are not returnable.

question: How do I return an item?
answer: Go to My Account > Orders, select the item and tap Return. Choose a reason and a pickup slot, and our courier will collect it from your address for free.

question: Can I exchange an item for a different size or color?
answer: Yes, size and color exchanges are free within 30 days of delivery, subject to stock. Select the item under My Account > Orders and tap Exchange.

question: How long does a refund take?
variants: when will i get my refund
answer: Refunds are issued within 2 business days after we receive the returned item. UPI and wallet refunds arrive instantly, cards take 5 to 7 business days, and net banking takes 3 to 5 days.

question: Where will my refund be credited?
variants: refund for cash on delivery order
how do i receive my refund
answer: Refunds go back to the original payment method. For cash on delivery orders, you can choose a bank transfer or ShopEase wallet credit, which is instant.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept UPI, credit and debit cards, net banking, ShopEase wallet, EMI on eligible cards, and cash on delivery for orders up to Rs. 10,000.

question: Is cash on delivery available?
answer: Yes, cash on delivery is available for orders up to Rs. 10,000 in most pin codes. A small handling fee of Rs. 20 applies.

question: My payment failed but money was deducted
variants: money debited but order not placed
answer: Don't worry - if money was deducted for a failed payment, it's automatically reversed to your account within 5 to 7 business days. If it hasn't arrived after that, share your transaction ID and we'll raise it with the bank.

question: How do I download my invoice?
answer: You can download your invoice from My Account > Orders > select the order > Download Invoice. GST invoices are available if you added your GSTIN at checkout.

question: Do you offer EMI options?
answer: Yes, EMI is available on orders above Rs. 3,000 with most major credit cards, and no-cost EMI is offered on selected products. You'll see EMI options at checkout.

question: My coupon code is not working
answer: Coupons usually fail because of a minimum order value, an expiry date, or product exclusions. Check the coupon's terms under Offers; each coupon can only be used once per account.

question: The price dropped after I bought it, can I get the difference?
variants: cheaper now than when i bought
answer: We don't offer price protection on completed orders. However, if the item hasn't shipped, you can cancel and reorder at the new price.

question: How do I create an account?
answer: Tap Sign Up on the app or website and enter your mobile number or email. You'll get a one-time password to verify, and your account is ready in under a minute.

question: How do I reset my password?
variants: cannot log in to my account
answer: On the login page, tap 'Forgot Password' and enter your registered email or phone number. You'll receive a reset link or OTP valid for 15 minutes.

question: How do I update my phone number or email?
answer: Go to My Account > Profile and tap Edit. Changing your phone number or email requires OTP verification on the new contact.

question: How do I delete my account?
answer: You can request account deletion from My Account > Settings > Delete Account. It's processed within 7 days once there are no pending orders or refunds, and it can't be undone.

question: I think my account was hacked
answer: Please reset your password immediately and log out of all devices from Settings > Security. I'm also flagging this for our security team - a human agent will contact you within 2 hours.

question: How does the ShopEase wallet work?
answer: ShopEase wallet holds refunds and gift card balances. It's applied automatically at checkout, and the balance is shown under My Account > Wallet. Wallet money can't be transferred to a bank.

question: What is ShopEase Plus membership?
answer: ShopEase Plus costs Rs. 999 a year and gives you free express delivery, early access to sales, and 5% extra cashback on every order.

question: How do I use a gift card?
answer: Redeem a gift card from My Account > Wallet > Add Gift Card. The balance is added to your wallet and applied automatically at checkout. Gift cards are valid for 1 year.

question: Does my product have a warranty?
answer: Electronics and appliances carry the manufacturer's warranty, usually 1 year. Warranty claims go through the brand's service center; the warranty card and your invoice are all you need.

question: When will an out of stock item be available?
answer: We can't confirm restock dates, but tap 'Notify Me' on the product page and we'll alert you by SMS and email the moment it's back.

question: Are your products genuine?
answer: Yes, all products are sourced directly from brands or authorized sellers. If you ever suspect an item isn't genuine, report it and we'll issue a full refund after verification.

question: How do I find the right size?
answer: Every clothing and footwear page has a Size Chart link below the size options. If it doesn't fit, size exchanges are free within 30 days.

question: How can I contact customer care?
answer: You can reach us 24/7 through this assistant, by calling 1800-123-4567 (toll-free), or by emailing support@shopease.example.

question: What are your customer support hours?
answer: This assistant is available 24/7. Human agents are available by phone from 8 AM to 10 PM, all seven days.

question: I want to file a complaint
variants: i am not happy with the service
answer: I'm sorry you've had a bad experience. I've noted your complaint and can connect you to a senior agent - you'll also get a ticket number by email within a few minutes so you can track it.

question: How can I become a seller on ShopEase?
answer: Visit sell.shopease.example and register with your GSTIN, PAN and bank details. Verification usually takes 2 to 3 business days.

question: How is my personal data protected?
answer: Your data is encrypted and we never sell it to third parties. Card details are handled by PCI-DSS certified payment partners and are never stored on our servers.
